title.zh: 刑事诉讼法典（指定执法机构）公告 2011
title.en: Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Law Enforcement Agency) Notification 2011

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. This Notification may be cited as the Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Law Enforcement Agency) Notification 2011 and shall come into operation on 18th July 2011.

2. The Ministry of Health (Health Regulation Group) and the Health Sciences Authority (Vigilance, Compliance and Enforcement Cluster, Health Products Regulation Group) are prescribed as law enforcement agencies for the purposes of section 112(1)(c) of the Code.
[S 175/2020 wef 19/03/2020]
